name: @lastcoinvision/tx-builders
description: Fixed-fee wrappers over @lastcoinvision/sdk's module clients (identity, registry, voting, taxrail), wired to a wallet-core signer. Every sdk client method defaults its own `fee` parameter to "auto" -- that default is broken on this chain (see DECISIONS.md, 2026-08-03). This package exists so a wallet UI never has a code path that can reach that default: every method here takes a required, explicit StdFee (or a wallet-core TESTNET_DEFAULT_FEES constant), and the signer address is supplied once at connect time, not per call.

scripts.lint: grep -rn --include='*.ts' '"auto"' src && exit 1 || echo 'no auto-fee strings found'
